name: Tidlor Holdings Public Company Limited
summary: Tidlor Holdings Public Company Limited, a financial services firm founded in 2006 and based in Bangkok, Thailand, primarily offers secured loans to self-employed small business owners across the country. These loans leverage vehicles such as motorcycles, sedan-pickups, and trucks as collateral. Additionally, the company operates as an insurance brokerage, facilitating a range of life and non-life policies, including coverage for automobiles, personal accidents, cancer, and mandatory third-party liability. By August 11, 2022, Tidlor had established a substantial network of 1,484 branches spanning 74 provinces.
